# Spar 0.6.8

**Submissions are now durable, inspectable parts of a learning conversation.** This release also makes the agent thread easier to navigate, shows model context and connected account details, and fixes a desktop development startup race.

## Submission history and references

- Each local or remote submission records a bounded snapshot of the code that was sent alongside its verdict and case results. Earlier submissions remain visible, with their available evidence, even when they predate code snapshots.
- Challenge pages show submission history. A submission can be opened to inspect its code and graded cases.
- The tutor can read submission summaries or one submission in detail and link directly to the evidence in its reply.
- Type `@` in the composer to reference a challenge, submission, or concept. Challenge and submission links in the thread open the corresponding record.

## A clearer learning thread

- Agent replies have copy and feedback actions; feedback is saved with the reply and can be changed or cleared.
- The composer shows context window usage beside the selected model, with connected subscription quota details when available.
- Activity, tool details, cards, and references have clearer spacing and typography. The thread keeps a visible working indicator while a turn is waiting between steps.
- Navigation, the toolbar, sidebar, and workspace pages have refined layout and transitions.

## Settings and development

- Settings can identify the account behind a connected ChatGPT, Claude, or GitHub Copilot subscription when the provider makes that information available.
- Desktop development startup waits for a complete visualizer build before launching Electron, avoiding partial generated output during watcher updates.
